title: Influencer Stella Tzortzi on building a brand inspired by Mediterranean hair oiling rituals
summary: Influencer Stella Tzortzi built Cee Cee from scratch. Now, the content creator is ready for the world to try her culturally-driven, natural hair care inspired by Mediterranean hair oiling rituals passed down from generation to generation

extraction.key_fact: 인플루언서 스텔라 초르치가 지중해식 헤어 오일링에서 착안한 헤어케어 브랜드를 만들었다.
